description: Start a video: a title, the brief (who it's for, what it must show, the one thing to feel), the shape (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5) and the length in seconds. The platform drafts the storyboard from the brief (a little model time, billed like an agent's); then shape it with set_video_shots or ask the Creative Director (ask_agent creative, with `production`). `draft: false` makes an empty video to fill yourself.

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

engine.description: only when the person asks for a method: remotion is a code film, ffmpeg the joiner; otherwise the Creative Director picks
